title: Chocolate Chip Fluffernutter Blondies
description: Chocolate, marshmallows, and peanut butter unite in these blondies, a mashup of peanut butter blossoms and fluffernutter sandwiches.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Beat butter, brown sugar, peanut butter, and white sugar together in a bowl until smooth and creamy. Add egg and egg yolk and mix gently. Gradually stir in flour, baking soda, and salt just until batter is mixed. Gently fold chocolate chips and marshmallows into batter. Spread batter into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes. The center will set as it cools. Cool completely before slicing, about 30 minutes.

video.description: Get ready to throw the ultimate tailgate party from start to finish! In this step-by-step guide, Nicole shows you how to cook a full game day spread with crowd-pleasing dips, handheld bites, fun desserts, and festive drinks—plus expert tips for prepping, packing, and decorating your tailgate setup. Whether you're tailgating in the parking lot or hosting a watch party at home, this video has everything you need to make game day delicious and stress-free. From layered dips and marinated hot dogs to fluffernutter brownies and a watermelon helmet fruit tray, Nicole shares easy, winning recipes that are guaranteed to be fan favorites. You’ll also learn how to build the perfect Bloody Mary bar, mix up a Yellowhammer cocktail, and pull together a fully styled tailgate station with all the essentials and more. With simple, make-ahead ideas and playful presentation tips, this guide will help you bring your A-game to every kickoff.
